well: ODP Holes 110-671A/B/C/D (the historic first-ever drilling THROUGH an active decollement, 691.2 m penetration), 110-672A (incoming-plate reference), 110-673A/B and 110-676A - BARBADOS RIDGE accretionary complex, Lesser Antilles, North Atlantic (15.52-15.54 N, 58.64-58.81 W; seafloors -4,678 to -5,070 m, the catalogue's deepest Atlantic water); ODP Leg 110 (1986), samples 4.40-496.70 mbsf reaching the sediments immediately above the incipient decollement
operator_on_log: Taylor & Leonard laboratory consolidation testing (oedometer + triaxial, vertical AND horizontal orientations) on whole-round core samples; drilling by JOIDES Resolution - the leg that founded modern decollement science and led directly to the first subduction-zone CORKs (Leg 156)
source_database: PANGAEA, dataset doi:10.1594/PANGAEA.747753 ('Geotechnical and physical properties from whole-round consolidation samples of ODP Leg 110 holes (Table 1)'); supplement to Taylor & Leonard 1990, Proc. ODP Sci. Results 110, 289-308 (doi:10.2973/odp.proc.sr.110.152.1990); full paper abstract preserved in the file's own header

fetch_method: read-only HTTPS fetch of the PANGAEA textfile export - COMPLETE dataset (874 data points per the header's own Size declaration, re-counted at gate time as non-empty body cells excluding Event + geocode columns, EXACT) in one fetch
coverage: COMPLETE DATASET: 41 consolidation-test rows across 8 holes and 4 sites - wet-bulk/grain density, water content, porosity, void ratio, effective overburden stress 20-3,808 kPa, preconsolidation pressure (max/min), the Pc-Po state columns, permeability at Pc (1.2e-8 to 7.6e-4 cm/s), compression index, vane shear strength, grain-size fractions, shipboard CaCO3, and full Atterberg limits; test orientations (vertical/horizontal/triaxial) ride verbatim in three comment columns
curves: WBD, grain density, water content, porosity, void ratio
Pc/Po (max)/(min) - ACTUALLY Pc MINUS Po in kPa, see anomaly disclosure
Coeff of permeability at Pc [cm/s] + compression index Cc + vane shear [kPa]
Event rides as per-row quality; lithology/epoch/orientation comments verbatim
source_anomaly_disclosure: SIX source quirks preserved verbatim, each proven by arithmetic where provable: (1) the two columns LABELED 'Overconsolidation ratio (Pc/Po)' actually hold the DIFFERENCE Pc - Po in kPa - re-derived on all 66 populated pairs, 65 close within 1 kPa (including 3000 - 3808 = -808 at the deepest sample) and the single violator (672A-2H-3 horizontal min: 100 - 37 = 63 vs archived 43) is a genuine 20-kPa arithmetic slip in the source table, carried unchanged; (2) sample 671C-1X-1 archives a permeability of literally 0.000000000 cm/s - a value that underflowed the table's 9-decimal format (physically nonzero, numerically zero in the archive); (3) all TEN 672A rows with Atterberg data have the Plastic-limit column DUPLICATING the Liquid limit (e.g. 87.4/87.4 with PI 56), breaking PI = LL - PL exactly where every other site closes it (worst deviation 3.6 on 23 non-672A rows); (4) epoch 'early Plocene' typo (672A-11H-3); (5) sample label '110-673A2H-3-2' missing its hyphen; (6) 'Water content, wet mass' exceeds 100% on five rows (103-120%) - impossible on a wet-mass basis, so those values are dry-mass water contents under a wet-mass label
purpose: thirty-sixth catalogue entry - the BARBADOS RIDGE / LESSER ANTILLES joins as region TWENTY-FOUR (the birthplace of decollement drilling and of the CORK) and consolidation geotechnics is kind TWENTY-FIVE: preconsolidation state, permeability, compressibility and plasticity - the quantities that turn the catalogue's measured pore pressures (U1324) and strengths into a MECHANISM; the paper's 'lubricated subduction' headline is re-derived by the gate on every run: every sample at or below 90 mbsf is UNDERCONSOLIDATED (Pc - Po < 0, reaching -916 kPa), the pore fluid carrying what the grain framework cannot - and at the deepest sample above the decollement Pc/Po = 3000/3808 = 0.79, the excess-pressure state approaching overburden that lets an ocean plate slide
verified: 41 rows / 874 counted cells against the header's own Size declaration (EXACT); the Pc-Po difference identity re-derived on all 66 populated pairs (65 within 1 kPa, the single 20-kPa source slip disclosed and pinned); ALL 13 samples >= 90 mbsf underconsolidated with minimum Pc-Po = -916 kPa; 672A PL==LL duplication pinned on all 10 rows vs PI=LL-PL closing within 3.6 on all 23 other-site rows; the zero-permeability underflow cell pinned; epoch typo + missing-hyphen label pinned; gate-pinned; source URL serves the identical dataset
